isolation: Independent emperor penguin winter polynya lane; do not alter current Adélie isotope manuscript
question: Within the same colony and after shared year adjustment, are April-August coastal polynyas associated with emperor penguin spring abundance indices?
prediction: positive; test two-sided and retain opposite/null signs

outcome.caution: modelled spring attendance index, not direct annual nest count, breeding success, or posterior draws

exposure.time_window: April 1 through August 31 of the SAME year
exposure.classification: positive even integer Map ID = coastal polynya; open ocean -2 is NOT counted
exposure.metric: log1p(mean daily nominal km2 of coastal polynya pixels within radius)
exposure.georeference: LonLat.nc geographical coordinates; NEVER interpret daily x and y as metric coordinates

model.inference: sea-ice-region cluster-robust t and 2^G wild cluster sign flips
model.sensitivity: colony + region-by-year fixed effects, leave-one-region-out, 50km and 200km radii
model.screen_success: positive primary coefficient AND signflip two-sided p<=0.05 AND positive stringent model AND every leave-one-region-out coefficient positive

stop_conditions: LonLat.nc absent or NetCDF shapes mismatch
paper_gate: REQUIRES full LaRue posterior uncertainty propagation and independent sea-ice-concentration baseline; without these only descriptive screening

audit.notes: Raw images are not independent modelled count estimates, and LaRue filters surveys
